label: Where
value: On the road between Mingora and Saidu Sharif, Swat District
quote: a museum located in Saidu Sharif, on the road connecting Mingora

label: What to see
value: Gandharan statuettes and friezes of the Buddha's life, seals, small reliquaries
quote: The museum contains Gandharan statuettes and friezes depicting the lives of the Buddha along with seals, small reliquaries and other treasures, mostly from Butkara No 1 and Odigram

label: Also inside
value: An ethnographic gallery of carved Swati furniture, jewellery and embroidery
quote: an ethnographic gallery with traditional carved Swati furniture, jewelry and embroideries

label: Origin
value: Conceived in 1959 by the Italian Archaeological Mission and the Wali of Swat
quote: The museum was conceived in 1959 under the aegis of the Italian Archaeological Mission to Swat and the Wali of Swat

label: Closures
value: Closed during the conflict; its contents were moved to Taxila
quote: the museum was closed and its contents were moved to Taxila

label: New building
value: A seismic-resistant museum opened on 11 December 2014
quote: a new seismic-resistant museum was opened on December 11, 2014.
